metadata.description: AI agent skills for Isambard HPC systems

plugins.name: slurm
plugins.description: Submit, monitor, and manage HPC jobs using Slurm on Isambard-AI (GH200 GPU) and Isambard 3 (Grace CPU, MACS) systems.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Install and manage Python environments on Isambard using Conda (Miniforge), uv, or Cray Python. Covers virtual environments, building aarch64 packages from source, compiler flags, mpi4py, and finding arm64-compatible packages.

plugins.name: modules
plugins.description: Use the modules system, Cray Programming Environments (PrgEnv-gnu, PrgEnv-cray), compiler wrappers (cc, CC, ftn), GNU and NVIDIA compilers, and profiling tools (gprof, Cray perftools, Nsight) on Isambard.

plugins.name: spack
plugins.description: Install, configure, and use Spack to build HPC software on Isambard-AI and Isambard 3. Covers Miniforge setup, the buildit config repository, Spack environments, concretizing, installing, and targeting neoverse_v2 / aarch64.

plugins.name: containers
plugins.description: Run containers on Isambard using Podman-HPC and Apptainer (formerly Singularity). Covers pulling, building, and migrating images, GPU access, single-node and multi-node MPI/NCCL workloads over Slingshot 11, and aarch64 image selection.

plugins.name: mpi
plugins.description: Use MPI on Isambard with Cray MPICH, OpenMPI, or conda-installed MPI. Covers PrgEnv loading, PMI types (cray_shasta, pmi2, pmix), srun --mpi flags, libfabric and Slingshot 11 performance, and why mpirun/mpiexec must not be used.

plugins.name: nccl
plugins.description: Use NCCL for multi-node GPU communication on Isambard-AI over Slingshot 11. Covers the brics/nccl module, aws-ofi-nccl plugin, Slingshot environment variables, building NCCL from source, benchmarking with nccl-tests, and NCCL in Apptainer containers.

plugins.name: cuda
plugins.description: Use GPUs and CUDA on Isambard-AI (NVIDIA GH200, sm_90). Covers loading cudatoolkit/nvhpc modules, compiling with nvcc -arch=sm_90, CUDA forward compatibility for newer CUDA versions via NGC containers, NVIDIA HPC SDK, or conda cuda-compat.
